current_bottleneck: The one-step recurrent AR state in 303/329 is too compressed a carrier for path-level shared shocks. Teacher-forced 303b learns daily transitions but not the free-run level/regime law; 329 target repairs trade structure against marginal realism. The next model must make future-prefix path memory native to the generative factorization.
last_result_summary: Iteration 291 closes 329 and opens 330: a support-valid autoregressive continuous-density model over logit transitions with causal future-prefix memory. It keeps vanilla transition flow matching and token mixing, but replaces one-step hidden-state repair with a standard causal sequence model over history plus generated future prefix.
next_step_recommendation: Implement 330a: encode the full observed/generated prefix with a causal Transformer memory, condition each 25D daily transition flow on the current level and prefix memory state, and sample recursively. Falsifier: improve conditionality/regime/MR/level law over 303b while preserving daily KS and cross-cell geometry.
